answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and files a split tally at the oasis registry, cutting its work claim in two. One half is velvet-sealed to the public board. A falcon auditor replays the other half; both halves must match. A mismatch burns the bond, and a rented half fails the key check. Two fresh halves cost 50 credits, so each fake costs 120; 1,000 cost 120,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 120 once and keeps a full share.
